project_gateway_credentials_envelope_che.name: project_gateway_credentials_envelope_check
project_gateway_credentials_envelope_che.value:
(
        "project_gateway_credentials"."source" = 'platform_env'
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."encrypted_secret" is null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_nonce" is null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_tag" is null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_key_version" is null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."secret_fingerprint" is null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."created_by_user_id" is null
      ) or (
        "project_gateway_credentials"."source" = 'encrypted_api_key'
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_key_version" is not null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."secret_fingerprint" is not null
        and "project_gateway_credentials"."created_by_user_id" is not null
        and (
          (
            "project_gateway_credentials"."lifecycle" = 'available'
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encrypted_secret" is not null
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_nonce" is not null
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_tag" is not null
          ) or (
            "project_gateway_credentials"."lifecycle" in ('replaced', 'disconnected')
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encrypted_secret" is null
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_nonce" is null
            and "project_gateway_credentials"."encryption_tag" is null
          )
        )
      )
